summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 rework repaired the Table 2 and Table 3 activity matrices, corrected Table 4 cytotoxicity/hemolysis rows, and preserved database entry conflicts as cautions rather than blockers.
adjudication_summary: The original framework-test blocker is closed: all recoverable local activity/toxicity values from XML/PDF Tables 2-4 are represented with units and locators; linked database rows are reconciled or explicitly preserved as source_conflict; supplementary material was checked and does not add a missing endpoint matrix.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/OA package/supplementary PDF/database snapshots were sufficient for worker-2/4/6 repair; no blocking local material gap remains.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay rows and literature links are source-verified against article metadata and primary tables; mixed/entry-level APD6, CAMP, dbAMP, and DRAMP MP-C rows remain explicit source_conflict cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_gate: No blocking/major issue remains after source review; residual database and supplement limitations are nonblocking cautions with source paths checked.
